Lisa · Listen & Shadow 03

Three Minutes on One Brand — the pitch, said better
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE PITCH
👤 Buyer
Which brand are you going to walk us through today?
어떤 브랜드를 소개해주실 건가요?
walk someone through ~ — ~를 차근차근 소개하다
💬 Lisa
Today I'd like to talk about Ramey, out of Sonoma.
오늘은 소노마의 Ramey에 대해 말씀드리겠습니다.
out of ~ — ~ 출신의, ~에 있는
같은 패턴으로 — Today I'd like to talk about our new Chardonnay. · Today I'd like to introduce two producers from Napa.
💬 Lisa
Let me give you some background: David Ramey founded it in 1996.
배경부터 말씀드리면, 데이비드 레이미가 1996년에 세운 와이너리예요.
background — 배경 · found — 세우다
같은 패턴으로 — Let me give you some background on the region first. · Let me give you some context before the numbers.
💬 Lisa
What sets them apart is the way they make Chardonnay — the traditional way.
다른 점은 전통 방식으로 샤르도네를 만든다는 거예요.
set apart — 다르게 만들다, 돋보이게 하다 · traditional — 전통적인
같은 패턴으로 — What sets them apart is their price point. · What sets this one apart is the age of the vines.
💬 Lisa
That brings me to the balance.
그래서 균형 얘기로 이어지는데요.
that brings me to ~ — 그래서 ~ 얘기로 이어진다
같은 패턴으로 — That brings me to the price. · That brings me to why we chose them.
💬 Lisa
Which is exactly why it works so well with food.
바로 그래서 이 와인이 음식과 잘 어울리는 거죠.
which is exactly why ~ — 바로 그래서 ~
같은 패턴으로 — Which is exactly why we picked it for the list. · Which is exactly why it sells out every year.
💬 Lisa
On top of that, it's been very well received in Korea.
거기에 더해, 한국에서 반응이 아주 좋았어요.
on top of that — 거기에 더해 · well received — 반응이 좋은
같은 패턴으로 — On top of that, the price hasn't moved. · On top of that, they ship fast.
💬 Lisa
What that means for you is you can list it without worrying about stock.
그게 무슨 뜻이냐면, 재고 걱정 없이 리스트에 올릴 수 있다는 겁니다.
what that means for you is ~ — 그게 여러분께 의미하는 건 ~
같은 패턴으로 — What that means for you is a lower entry price. · What that means for you is fewer returns.
💬 Lisa
Where it gets interesting is the Cabernet.
흥미로운 지점은 카베르네예요.
where it gets interesting is ~ — 흥미로운 지점은 ~
같은 패턴으로 — Where it gets interesting is the older vintages. · Where it gets interesting is the second label.
PART 2 · SAY IT BETTER
👤 Buyer
Say that again — but as if the room were full of buyers.
좀 더 격식 있게 말한다면요?
as if ~ — 마치 ~인 것처럼
💬 Lisa
It's an exceptional wine.
정말 훌륭한 와인이에요.
exceptional — 아주 뛰어난 (really good보다 격이 높음)
같은 패턴으로 — It's a compelling wine. · It's an outstanding vintage.
💬 Lisa
We hold a significant amount of it.
상당한 양을 확보하고 있어요.
significant — 상당한 (a lot of보다 격이 높음)
같은 패턴으로 — We carry a wide range of their wines. · We hold a significant allocation.
💬 Lisa
It's had a strong response in the market.
시장 반응이 강했어요.
response — 반응 (people like it보다 격이 높음)
같은 패턴으로 — It's had a strong response from sommeliers. · The response has been consistent.
💬 Lisa
It sits at an accessible price point.
접근하기 좋은 가격대에 있어요.
price point — 가격대 · accessible — 부담 없는 (cheap 대신)
같은 패턴으로 — It sits at a premium price point. · It sits just under the competition.
💬 Lisa
There's nothing quite like it.
이런 와인은 흔치 않아요.
nothing quite like ~ — ~ 같은 건 없다 (really different 대신)
같은 패턴으로 — There's nothing quite like their Pinot. · There's nothing quite like that vineyard.
💬 Lisa
From what we've seen, it's the strongest seller at this price.
저희가 본 바로는, 이 가격대에서 제일 잘 나가요.
from what we've seen — 저희가 본 바로는 (I think 대신)
같은 패턴으로 — From what we've seen, the demand is steady. · The data suggests it's growing.
PART 3 · THE CLOSE
👤 Buyer
And how would you close?
마무리는 어떻게 하실 건가요?
close — 마무리하다
💬 Lisa
To sum up: it's balanced, it's proven, and it's ready to go.
정리하면, 균형 잡히고, 검증됐고, 준비돼 있습니다.
to sum up — 정리하면 · proven — 검증된
같은 패턴으로 — To sum up: two wines, one producer, ready this month. · To sum up, this is the one I'd start with.
💬 Lisa
I'm happy to take any questions.
질문 있으시면 지금 받겠습니다.
take questions — 질문을 받다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm happy to go deeper on any of that. · I'm happy to send samples.
녹음 19/19
